name: Godel Reverse Mathematics Calibration
description: Formalizes Godel numbering, incompleteness and RCA0-style calibration at WO omega-cubed below epsilon-zero. The Godel sentence is true exactly when unprovable and ConQ is independent.

program.name: Ordinals and Reverse Mathematics
program.summary: Guarded contextual derivations have single-exponential length with a matching lower family, the Dershowitz-Manna codes have order type ω^ω, the calibrated triple codes stay below ω^ω·2, and the projected dependency pair has height ω. The compiled Robinson-Q checker satisfies both incompleteness theorems, so Gödel's sentence and its negation share one provability record, and the size-change calibration enters as a recorded profile over a proved ω³ well-ordering.

oneLine: The Godel sentence holds in the standard model exactly when it is unprovable, so neither it nor its negation is provable and consistency is independent.
summary: The theory codes Robinson-Q syntax with polynomial pairing and beta sequences, with checked proof trees, a first-order proof relation and an arithmetized provability predicate plus its diagonal Godel sentence and consistency sentence. It asks what the checker proves versus what holds in the standard model, whether consistency is provable, and what RCA0-style strength the Arts-Giesl and size-change routes record at omega-cubed below epsilon-zero. The live provability predicate matches Provable, the Godel matrix evaluated at its own code is equivalent to unprovability of the Godel sentence, and the fixed-point semantics holds, giving unconditional independence of the Godel sentence. Consistency is true in the standard model with unprovable negation, while a one-infinite-element model falsifies the provability of falsity, so the checker proves neither consistency nor its negation. The recorded Arts-Giesl target is RCA0 plus well-ordering of omega-cubed below the epsilon-zero upper benchmark with conjectural status, matching bounds uninhabited and coarse and broad packages excluded from sharp packages, with sharp packages available only from supplied transfers or direct construction. Length envelopes for Arts-Giesl applications hold only under supplied graph, base-order, soundness and pair-count budgets with additivity and nonemptiness hypotheses.
boundary: The boundary is provability in the Robinson-Q checker versus truth in the standard model: every checked proof is true in every model of the axioms, yet the Godel sentence is true exactly when unprovable and consistency is true in the standard model but false in the one-infinite-element model, so neither the Godel sentence nor consistency is decided by the checker. The obstruction is the diagonal fixed point together with the beta-coded proof relation, which lets truth and provability separate and blocks any total recoding bridge across all conclusion codes. The calibration side locates the same divide at RCA0 plus well-ordering of omega-cubed strictly below epsilon-zero, where the recorded target, order and absence of matching bounds hold with conjectural status and sharp exactness holds only with supplied target-matching theories, ordinals and theorem-level evidence.

conclusions.statement: evalForm env0 arithGodelSentence holds if and only if arithGodelSentence is not Provable.
ArithGodelSentence is not Provable and its negation is not Provable: not Provable arithGodelSentence and not Provable (Formula.not arithGodelSentence) hold, with no additional hypotheses.
For every formula G, if evalForm env0 G holds if and only if G is not Provable, then neither G nor its negation is Provable.
For every formula phi, evalForm env0 (bewOf phi) holds if and only if Provable phi holds.
Given ArithGodelFixedPointSemantics and a proof of Provable (Formula.imp ConQ arithGodelSentence), Provable ConQ does not hold.
Under the hypothesis that Provable holds of Formula.imp ConQ arithGodelSentence, Provable ConQ does not hold.
The consistency sentence ConQ is true in the standard zero environment: evalForm env0 ConQ holds, with no additional hypotheses.
The negation of ConQ is not provable: not Provable (Formula.not ConQ) holds, with no additional hypotheses.

The recorded calibration target equals FormalTheory.RCA0_WO_omega3 and the upper benchmark equals FormalTheory.WO_epsilon0 and the target is less than the upper and there are no ArtsGieslMatchingBounds and the current calibration status equals CalibrationStatus.conjectural, with no additional hypotheses.
There is no inhabitant of ArtsGieslMatchingBounds.
There is no sharp package U with U.bound equal to artsGieslTheoremUpperBound.
There is no sharp package L with L.bound equal to artsGieslTheoremLowerBound.
evalForm (envUpdate env0 0 godelMatrixCode) godelMatrix holds if and only if arithGodelSentence is not Provable.
ArithGodelFixedPointSemantics holds, with no additional hypotheses.
For every bound L and every function f from Nat to Nat, there exist c and d such that for all i with i <= L, beta c d i equals f i.

openPoints: Reverse-mathematical equivalence of the Arts-Giesl route with RCA0 plus well-ordering of omega-cubed stays conjectural with the current packages.
Sharp upper and lower packages are available only from a supplied SCT transfer, theorem alignment, exact transfer with matching theory and ordinal hypotheses, or direct construction.

Unprovability of consistency from consistency needs a provable internal implication from consistency to the Godel sentence, which is true in the standard model but remains a hypothesis as a Hilbert derivation.
Substitution-trace completeness and the sound-complete recoding bridge hold only on canonical codes, with no total bridge across all conclusion codes.

Proof-length envelopes need supplied stage budgets, affine base-order bounds and pair-count bounds, and for the constant-two form at-least-one-rule and nonzero-size hypotheses, while construction cost is unbounded in rule size.
Ambient well-foundedness and descent for omega-cubed are proved in Lean, while deductive provability in RCA0 and method-specific termination adapters are not proved in the omega-cubed file.

subTopics.name: Godel coding and proof checker infrastructure
First incompleteness and truth versus provability

files.summary: The file turns the recorded Arts-Giesl reverse-mathematical calibration into a proved conjunction. It establishes the target value RCA0 with WO of omega cubed, the upper benchmark WO of epsilon zero, their order relation, uninhabited matching bounds, and conjectural status. Reverse-mathematical equivalence of the Arts-Giesl license with RCA0 plus WO of omega cubed remains conjectural.
files.conclusion: The recorded Arts-Giesl target, upper benchmark, their order, absence of matching bounds, and conjectural status all hold as stated.

files.summary: The file defines fixed-finite TRS metadata, graph, base-order and soundness budgets, audit records, and affine and pair-count bound witnesses. It proves additive proof-length envelopes and polynomial overhead expressions conditional on those supplied budgets. It bounds head-abstracted call obligations by rule count times signature size for head and first-order engines and instantiates the envelopes there. It specializes to a step-duplicating recursor with rule count two, signature size four, one pair, and a stipulated license overhead.
files.conclusion: One dependency-pair soundness application costs at most graph plus base-order plus soundness budgets, polynomially in rule and signature metadata, with recursor overhead 18 plus residual work.

files.summary: The file defines a coarse RCA0 Pi02 floor profile and theorem-level lower-bound record, sharp omega-cubed packages with independent well-ordering backing, a gap record comparing coarse and target profiles, SCT transfer records, and a direct sharp package. It proves profile equalities, order and inequality facts, exclusion of the coarse record from the sharp package, and conditional existences of sharp inhabitants from SCT, alignment, exact-transfer, and direct constructions. It also proves the two profile constructions agree on theory, ordinal, status, and erased presentations.
files.conclusion: Coarse lower bounds stay below the omega-cubed target while sharp packages exist conditionally or directly with independent well-ordering backing.

files.summary: The file defines a base-order proof-length function with explicit additivity, finite TRS shapes using maximum rule size, and three stage costs with their total. It proves a bound with constant two derived from the stage definitions under at-least-one-rule and nonzero-size hypotheses. It proves construction cost is unbounded in rule size and gives the recursor closed form four times m plus two with input-independent overhead.
files.conclusion: One Arts-Giesl application costs at most twice the rule-size construction term plus base-order length, with an explicit recursor closed form.

files.summary: This file packages Arts-Giesl calibration metadata around the target theory RCA0_WO_omega3 with ordinal ceiling omega^3. It defines a conjectural current calibration from the registered WO(epsilon0) upper and RCA0 lower packages, conditional exact-calibration constructors that set status exact only from supplied profile equalities or sharp upper and lower packages, and parallel SCT-transfer and theorem-alignment routes that agree fieldwise after tag erasure. It proves the matching-bounds assumptions are uninhabited for the current lower package and that no exact-theorem-calibration record can reuse the current coarse upper, lower, or combined packages.
files.conclusion: The current coarse packages do not yield an exact-theorem calibration, while supplied sharp target-matching bounds yield only record-field exactness conditional on those equalities.

files.summary: This file defines the broad Arts-Giesl upper-bound package at theory WO(epsilon0) with ordinal epsilon0 and theorem-level evidence. It proves the target theory RCA0_WO_omega3 lies below it in the finite register and omega^3 is below epsilon0, and it defines sharp exact-target packages that add theory, ordinal and status equalities plus a Lean backing proof for WO(omega^3) with conditional builders from SCT or alignment data. It proves the broad package differs from the target in theory and ordinal and cannot equal any sharp package, while the conditional routes agree on theory, ordinal and status.
files.conclusion: The broad WO(epsilon0) package is strictly above the RCA0_WO_omega3 target and not sharp, while supplied alignment or transfer data yield sharp exact-target upper packages.

files.summary: The file defines polynomial pairing, Godel beta coding, arithmetized substitution on term and formula codes, and first-order graphs for numeral codes, Hilbert-sequence justification, proof and substitution relations, provability and consistency. It proves that every finite function is beta representable, that code substitution matches object substitution, and that proof-code existence is equivalent to Provable. It constructs the diagonal matrix and Godel sentence with its code identity.
files.conclusion: There is a first-order proof relation and provability predicate with a diagonal Godel sentence whose code identity holds, and proof-code existence is equivalent to Provable.

files.summary: The file develops Hilbert-Bernays derivability conditions for the proof checker, with D1 packing, D2 modus ponens on proof trees and on Provable, and a meta D3 lift distinguished from the internal implication Bew phi to Bew Bew phi. It proves the final Hilbert-Bernays step from not Bew false implies G to unprovability of consistency, plus soundness-based independence from a Godel equivalence. A constant 0 equals 0 predicate is shown to satisfy internal D3 without representing the checker.
files.conclusion: A representing checker with a syntactic fixed point G equal not Bew G yields independence of G, while the constant true predicate shows internal D3 alone does not imply representation.

files.summary: The file builds Nat-evaluation infrastructure for numCodeRel and recursive term and formula substitution tables, including freshness, beta chains and code-shape recognizers for Q axioms. It certifies postorder traversals so children precede parents and uses them to prove soundness and completeness of substitution traces. The stated consumers are proofRel and substRel semantics and the diagonal equivalence for the Godel sentence.
files.conclusion: Numeral coding and term and formula substitution tables are sound and complete in Nat with certified postorder traces and exact axiom-code recognition.

files.summary: The file proves Godel first incompleteness for the ProofTree checker: a sentence equivalent on Nat to its own unprovability is independent, with a conditional arithmetic instance under an explicit fixed-point premise and a representability form. It shows falsum is not such a sentence, derives semantic and syntactic omega-consistency of Q from Nat soundness, and proves meta-level consistency forbids proving both a formula and its negation. A dummy proof order is shown unused at meta level and q1 is shown not Rosser independent.
files.conclusion: Any sentence true exactly when unprovable is independent, and Q is omega-consistent and consistent, while falsum and q1 are not Godel or Rosser independent sentences.

files.summary: The file proves that the arithmetized provability predicate bewOf is semantically equivalent to the live proof calculus. It evaluates the Godel matrix body at its own code to obtain provability of the Godel sentence, negates to the fixed-point equivalence that the Godel sentence is true exactly when unprovable, and discharges the previously explicit premise. It concludes unconditional first incompleteness for the compiled Robinson-Q checker, with axiom checks included.
files.conclusion: The live arithmetized provability predicate is correct and its Godel sentence is true exactly when unprovable, giving unconditional first incompleteness.

files.summary: The file interprets live terms, formulas and environments in an arbitrary arithmetic structure and pins this semantics to the existing Nat evaluator. It defines models of the seven Q axioms and proves closed-term substitution and derived-connective semantics generally. It proves the live checker sound in every model of those axioms, hence every Provable formula true in all such models, agreeing with Nat soundness.
files.conclusion: Every checked Q proof is true in every arithmetic structure modelling the seven Q axioms, specializing to the standard Nat soundness.

files.summary: This file adds the full first-order induction schema to the compiled Robinson-Q checker over the same named-variable syntax, with a decidable syntactic recognizer and extended checker checkI and ProvableI. It proves capture-safe substitution semantics for the step term S(x), Nat-validity of every induction instance, and soundness of the extended checker. It also gives an independent Hilbert presentation CompiledIDerives with an exact adequacy equivalence and embedding of Q.
files.conclusion: Every ProvableI formula is true in Nat, so the induction checker is consistent and exactly captured by CompiledIDerives.

files.summary: This file promotes the fixed-point semantic graph of bewOf to the RepresentsChecker interface and records unconditional semantic consequences. It proves ConQ true in the standard model and its negation unprovable, plus the standard-model truth of ConQ implies the Godel sentence. It isolates the remaining Godel-II theorem at the single hypothesis that the checker proves that implication.
files.conclusion: ConQ is unconditionally true with unprovable negation, while unprovability of ConQ remains conditional on the internal implication.

files.summary: This file builds a nonstandard model with carrier Option Nat where none is one infinite element absorbing for addition and largely for multiplication. It verifies all seven live Robinson-Q axioms in the model. It then shows an infinite beta-packed sequence certifies the code of falsity, so the internal consistency sentence fails there, yielding unconditional model-theoretic Godel-II and independence of ConQ.
files.conclusion: The live compiled checker does not prove its consistency sentence, and ConQ is independent of it.

files.summary: This file fills the Lawvere absence record on a new Godel object over the kernel carrier Trace with external finite schematic codes, evaluation, const-quotation and diagonal. It proves evaluation is never the second projection, every schematic map is identity or constant, and successor is neither schematic nor code-represented. It exports Lawvere code and evaluation maps, Godel packages, and partial and unit-valued escapes, showing every schematic map has a fixed point.
files.conclusion: Successor is not schematic or code-represented, and every schematic map is identity or constant with a fixed point.

files.summary: This file views the Godel sentence and its negation through a provability observer versus a standard-truth target. It restates the imported first incompleteness as one shared provability observation with two truth values. It applies the observer calculus to derive no licence, maximal refusals on each side, lift-or-refuse and swap-stabilizer facts, adding no new proof of incompleteness.
files.conclusion: The Godel pair collides provability against truth, yielding refusals and no greatest licensed set.

files.summary: This file takes the partiality escape from the total schematic collapse with a fuelled interpreter, tagged encode and decode-quote, and convergence versus divergence behaviours. It shows successor is behaviourally and quote-represented with argument-dependent non-identity behaviour. It proves the compose-succ-call composite diverges at its own code because convergence would fix delta, with Kleene recursion forms and freeze-live substitution contrasts.
files.conclusion: Successor is behaviourally quote-represented while its diagonal composite diverges at its own code, escaping the total collapse.

files.summary: The file studies partial codes with composition, successor, projection, constants, divergence and a self-referential call operation, together with convergence, divergence and size measures on traces. It classifies every total code as either constant or iterated successor and proves size bounds that prevent compound or delta-app values from arising from too-small codes. It defines left-head and remainder operations and two generated-operator families, left composition and freeze-substitution of successor. It proves every left-composition operator has an extensional fixed point while freeze-substitution of successor has none, and it shows the eqW freeze restores kernel confluence without stabilizing quotation and blocks rank transport for self-licensing.
files.conclusion: Freeze-substitution of successor has no extensional fixed point whereas every left-composition operator does.

files.summary: The file defines two injective pairings on naturals, an exponential pairing npair with 2-adic inverse and a polynomial pairing cpair with square-based inverse, plus nested cons, head, tail and list encodings with decode round-trips. It introduces a basic combinator type PR with zero, successor, projection, constant, pairing and composition and its evaluator, with concrete successor, pairing, identity and plus-two examples. It defines Lean-level iteration natIter and derives addition from it, showing successor and pairing lie in the basic fragment while addition uses the separate iteration schema. The file states it does not establish standard primitive-recursive closure for later syntax functions and proves no incompleteness theorem.
files.conclusion: Both exponential and polynomial pairings are injective with explicit inverses and injectively encode finite lists, with successor and pairing in the basic fragment and addition obtained only via separate iteration.

files.summary: The file connects the live polynomial pairing, positive cons constructor and numeral coder to Mathlib's standard primitive-recursive class. It proves cpair is binary primitive recursive from addition and multiplication, ccons is binary primitive recursive from successor and cpair, and numCode is primitive recursive by recursion over the cons algebra. It packages the three facts as code_algebra_primrec and states that syntax, substitution and proof-checking layers remain outside this package.
files.conclusion: The live pairing, cons and numeral-coding functions all lie in Mathlib's primitive-recursive class.

files.summary: This file builds numeric substitution and axiom recognition directly on Gödel codes. It defines general term and formula substitution on codes and proves they compute the live syntactic substitutions on canonical codes and are primitive recursive by course-of-values recursion. It defines numeric tag, payload and equality operations and Boolean recognizers for the Robinson Q axioms and the equality-reflexivity, identity, K, DNE and S axiom schemas. It proves the full numeric axiom recognizer is primitive recursive and agrees with the live axiom predicate on every encoded formula.
files.conclusion: General term and formula substitution and the full numeric axiom recognizer are primitive recursive and agree with the live syntactic operations on canonical codes.

files.summary: This file gives a direct closed-term recognizer and proof-tree checker acting only on natural-number Gödel codes with 0 as rejection. It proves the numeric closed-term test agrees with the live predicate on canonical term codes and is primitive recursive by strong recursion. It proves the numeric proof-tree checker agrees with the live syntactic checker on canonical proof codes and is primitive recursive by strong recursion. It packages pairing, constructors, unpairing, closed-term recognition, numeral and arbitrary substitution and the Boolean proof relation as an acceptable numbering precondition.
files.conclusion: The direct numeric proof-tree checker is primitive recursive and coincides with the live checker on canonical codes, yielding a primitive-recursive Boolean proof relation.

files.summary: This file exposes course-of-values recursion for numeral substitution on arithmetic syntax codes. It defines previous-value lookup and term and formula substitution steps and proves each step agrees with the live substitution functions. It proves term and formula substitution on live Gödel codes are primitive recursive via strong recursion.
files.conclusion: Numeral substitution for terms and formulas on live Gödel codes is primitive recursive via course-of-values recursion.

files.summary: This file closes the arithmetic decoder layer left open by the closure module by implementing the square-pairing inverse through bounded primitive recursion. It defines the shell predicate, shell output, and one inverse-search step and proves each primitive recursive. It defines head and tail accessors for positive constructor codes, proves they are primitive recursive and correct, and packages all operations in a closed structure.
files.conclusion: The live polynomial pairing inverse and the head and tail accessors for positive constructor codes are primitive recursive and compute correctly.

files.summary: This file builds beta-packed object-language certificates for term substitution, formula substitution, closed terms, axioms, and Hilbert lines and proves completeness of each trace encoding. It proves every checked recursive proof tree yields a proofRel certificate and every proofRel certificate reconstructs a provable decoded formula. It defines proofRecoding from decoded checker proofs to packed certificates, proves a sound and complete bridge on canonical formula codes with variable-zero and variable-one-two adapters, and proves no total bridge can work because an alias equality code is accepted for the same proof with a different target.
files.conclusion: Every checked proof recodes to a sound beta-packed proofRel certificate and every proofRel certificate proves the decoded formula, but no total recoding can work for all conclusion codes.

files.summary: This file defines behavior join at a trace and a quote-and-eval configuration with steps for reduction under quotation, convergent evaluation, and divergent evaluation. It shows quotation of merge void void converges while quotation of void diverges, so the kernel merge-void pair does not join. It exhibits a two-reduction freeze peak to a value and to divergence that does not join, shows freezing quote congruence removes the under-quote arm while freezing only eqW leaves the peak, and classifies all extended quote critical pairs.
files.conclusion: The quoted merge-void peak has converging and diverging reductions that do not join, and the least freeze must include quote congruence because freezing only eqW does not remove the peak.

files.summary: This file defines Hilbert justification, Hilbert sequences allowing axiom, modus ponens, generalization and closed specialization, and Hilbert provability. It defines flattening of recursive proof trees into formula lists and proves the flattened last entry and nonemptiness for checked proofs. It proves every checked proof flattens to a Hilbert sequence and that provability coincides with Hilbert provability in both directions.
files.conclusion: Provability by checked proof trees coincides exactly with Hilbert provability via flattening.

files.summary: The file defines arithmetic terms and formulas, numerals, substitution, injective Godel coding with fuelled decoders, the seven Robinson Q axioms, logical axiom recognizers, and a checked ProofTree calculus. It defines standard Nat evaluation and proves that every Q axiom and logical axiom is Nat-true. It proves checker soundness, hence provability soundness and consistency, and contrasts the Nat model of Q1 with a collapsing Unit model that refutes Q1.
files.conclusion: Every proof-tree checked by the Q checker is true in Nat, so falsum is unprovable and the checker is consistent.

files.summary: This file states conditional Gödel second-incompleteness consequences for the arithmetized checker. It proves that exact representation of the proof checker by bewOf implies truth of the consistency sentence ConQ in the standard model and unprovability of its negation. It proves the final modus-ponens step from fixed-point semantics and a provable implication from ConQ to the Gödel sentence to unprovability of ConQ. It also proves that implication is true in the standard model given the fixed-point semantics, without claiming the representability or D3 premises have been discharged.
files.conclusion: Under exact fixed-point semantics and a provable implication from consistency to the Gödel sentence, the consistency sentence itself is unprovable.

files.summary: The file introduces a decidable compiled-Q axiom predicate and an independent inductive Hilbert derivability relation for exactly the implemented fragment. It proves that inductive derivations serialize to checked proof trees and conversely, giving a bidirectional equivalence with live provability. It lists the seven Q axioms, characterizes the arithmetical recognizer by membership, derives each axiom, and separates falsum from that layer.
files.conclusion: Inductive compiled-Q derivability coincides exactly with live checker provability and contains all seven Robinson Q axioms.

files.summary: The file keeps substRel unchanged and proves soundness of beta-coded formula-substitution traces on raw codes and completeness on canonical encodings via postorder tables. It packages the canonical graph used by the diagonal sentence. It proves substRel exactly graphs numeral substitution on formula codes, with decoding, uniqueness, and the Godel diagonal instance in both numeral and open-variable forms.
files.conclusion: The object-language substitution table is sound on raw codes, complete on canonical codes, and substRel exactly graphs numeral substitution with a unique diagonal output.

files.summary: The file defines ascent families, formula classes and formal theories, plus six-step structural profiles and reflection and diagonal evidence structures. It registers the dependency-pair confession on the primitive duplicator as realizing the six-step shape and as a reflection-family ascent with the Arts-Giesl 2000 license, explicitly not a Lawvere-Yanofsky diagonal. It records the Arts-Giesl license as Pi02, formalizable in ISigma1 and provable in PRA for fixed finite TRSs, stores a reverse-mathematical calibration target as a conjecture, and proves a constant-overhead linear bound for residual proof work.
files.conclusion: The dependency-pair confession is a reflection-family ascent with singleton certificate and Arts-Giesl license, not a Lawvere-Yanofsky diagonal, with Pi02 ISigma1 PRA licensing and linear residual work plus constant overhead.

files.summary: Defines the elementary arithmetical content forall m exists n (n < m or m = 0) behind the historically named predecessor-descent sentence, with a canonical alias. Proves the single-sorted standard carrier satisfies the object sentence if and only if the arithmetical property holds, with set elements satisfying the matrix vacuously and number elements carrying the Nat-statement. Deduces the standard model satisfies the sentence under both historical and canonical names from its truth over Nat by case on zero versus successor.
files.conclusion: The standard model satisfies the predecessor-descent sentence because every natural number is zero or has a smaller predecessor.

files.summary: Defines the generic natural-number measure-descent principle that any Nat-valued measure strictly decreasing along a relation certifies well-foundedness of the reversed relation. Proves the principle by embedding measures below the omega-cubed carrier. Instantiates it at the KO7 dependency-pair rank dpRank to obtain well-foundedness of the reverse dependency-pair relation DPPairRev.
files.conclusion: Natural-number measure descent certifies termination of the KO7 reverse dependency-pair relation.

files.summary: Defines the elementary predecessor-descent matrix not-IsSet x to (not-IsSet y and (y < x or x = 0)) and the sentence forall x exists y matrix, with historical SCT aliases. Proves the matrix is quantifier-free and the sentence is Pi02 and in prenex normal form via the cumulative classifier. Clarifies the aliases do not formalize dependency-pair or size-change termination soundness.
files.conclusion: The predecessor-descent sentence is a Pi02 prenex sentence with quantifier-free matrix.

files.summary: Defines a product record parameterized by a theory T grouping five facts: Pi02 shape and derivability of the predecessor sentence, canonical omega-cubed well-order descriptor, standard-model faithfulness, and KO7 rank-descent implication. Proves the record can be assembled from a supplied derivation plus imported component theorems. States explicitly the record does not prove SCT equivalence or that the predecessor sentence expresses Arts-Giesl soundness.
files.conclusion: The five predecessor, omega-cubed, faithfulness and KO7 facts assemble into one product record given a derivation of the predecessor sentence.

files.summary: Proves every model of the five-sentence finite predecessor-arithmetic theory satisfies the predecessor-descent sentence, using zero-or-successor to supply zero or a smaller predecessor and vacuous satisfaction at set elements. Restates this as first-order semantic entailment. Retains historical SCT names as compatibility aliases that do not formalize size-change or dependency-pair soundness.
files.conclusion: Every model of finite predecessor arithmetic satisfies the predecessor-descent sentence.

files.summary: Constructs a syntactic Hilbert derivation of the predecessor-descent sentence from zero-or-successor after all-introduction by case on IsSet via excluded middle. Uses self-witness with ex falso for the IsSet branch, self-witness with the equality disjunct for the zero branch, and predecessor mapping via ex_mono for the successor branch. Specializes to rca0BasicAxioms and to the product record.
files.conclusion: rca0BasicAxioms syntactically derives the predecessor-descent sentence, yielding the product record at that theory.

files.summary: Packages compiled bare-Newman facts into one conjunction: the Newman sentence is Pi11, holds in the standard model, is consistent with the RCA0 basic fragment, and recorded critical-pair joinability is quantifier-free. Imports the sentence classification and standard-model and consistency results. Declares kernel-only trust with no sorry, axiom or native_decide.
files.conclusion: Bare Newman is Pi11, true in the standard model, consistent with the basic fragment, with low joinability.

files.summary: Defines a cumulative prenex-prefix classifier as an inductive family with quantifier-free base, level bump, existential and universal introduction, and polarity dual, with Sigma and Pi wrappers and historical IsPi02. Proves base bridges, cumulativity, polarity change, quantifier introduction, and that every classified formula is prenex. Provides constructors for universal-existential level two, noting bump and dual break bijection with formula quantifiers.
files.conclusion: Every classified formula is prenex with explicit universal-existential level-two constructors.

files.summary: Re-exports the Dershowitz-Manna multiset order type exactly omega-omega with bi-directional order, boundedness and surjectivity as the confluence-axis descriptor. Caps the triple-lexicographic safe-measure image at omega-omega times two and below epsilon-zero for every trace. Records the ordinal height of the termination measure consumed by the Newman ascent without new ordinal arithmetic.
files.conclusion: The confluence measure has exact order type omega-omega, trace cap omega-omega times two, and lies below epsilon-zero.

files.summary: Upgrades the propositional calculus to open BoundedFormula with universal-closure reading to support generalization and specialization needed for forall-exists sentences. Defines DerivableFO with hypothesis, modus ponens, Hilbert axioms, quantifier, equality, connective and existential rules. Proves soundness against realization under every environment, hence M satisfies phi at level zero.
files.conclusion: DerivableFO is sound for open formulas under every environment.

files.summary: Encodes hypothetical derivability DerivableH as chained implications over DerivableFO for local open hypotheses. Proves lifting, context-S combinator, hypothetical modus ponens, assumption, deduction theorem and inverse. Provides hypothetical connective, quantifier, excluded-middle and weakening rules used for SCT case branches.
files.conclusion: Hypothetical reasoning with discharge is available definitionally over DerivableFO.

files.summary: Defines a paper-facing guarded Newman statement descriptor with ordinal bound, finite critical pairs, decidable local joinability and conclusion. Instantiates it at omega-omega times two with local joinability and SafeStep confluence. Proves exact omega-omega DM order type, lower-bound surjectivity, trace bound below omega-omega times two and below epsilon-zero, and closure by proven global confluence.
files.conclusion: The guarded Newman package closes with exact omega-omega descriptor lifted to omega-omega times two below epsilon-zero.

files.summary: Defines the GuardedNewmanUpper record with strong normalization, local joinability, global and contextual confluence, standard-model Newman upper and order bound. Assembles it from proven SafeStep normalization, local and global and contextual confluence, standard-model sentence and trace bound. Deduces every trace measure lies below epsilon-zero.
files.conclusion: SafeStep yields the full guarded Newman upper package with order bound below epsilon-zero.

files.summary: Defines the single-sorted L2 language with function symbols zero, successor, addition and multiplication and relations less-than, membership and IsSet for Simpson-style RCA0 encoding. Provides term builders including numerals and free and bounded atomic formula builders. Proves atoms quantifier-free and sample sentences prenex, including successor-ne-zero and no-greatest forall-exists shape.
files.conclusion: L2 with its term and atomic builders provides the reusable base for RCA0-style sentences with verified quantifier-free and prenex facts.

files.summary: Defines the arithmetical closure under negation, implication and number quantifiers and bare-Newman blocks conclusion, inductive step, body and sentence forall X IsSet X to (Ind to Concl). Defines set-guarded arithmetical and Pi11 as leading set universal over arithmetical body. Proves the body arithmetical and the sentence Pi11, and that fixed-system critical-pair joinability equality is quantifier-free and Sigma-zero.
files.conclusion: The bare-Newman sentence is Pi11 over an arithmetical body while fixed critical-pair joinability is quantifier-free.

files.summary: Proves the standard carrier satisfies the bare-Newman sentence by strong induction on Nat, with a set witness as Set Nat and number case by the predecessor hypothesis. Proves the standard model satisfies the five-sentence predecessor fragment and the eight Simpson basic axioms, giving satisfiability of each theory with Newman. Notes the lift to every model would need induction beyond the basic axioms.
files.conclusion: The standard model satisfies the bare-Newman sentence and both basic theories with it are satisfiable.

files.summary: Defines five number-relativized basic axioms zero-or-successor, less-than successor, successor-ne-zero, add-zero and irreflexivity, grouped as rca0BasicAxioms with canonical finite predecessor-arithmetic alias. Proves each holds in the standard carrier by number-or-set case analysis. Deduces the standard model satisfies the finite fragment, establishing satisfiability without induction or comprehension schemes.
files.conclusion: The finite predecessor-arithmetic fragment is satisfiable in the standard model.

files.summary: Defines the two-induction fragment as Simpson base plus two induction instances and builds a two-element Bool countermodel with zero as set, successor identity and less-than as equality. Shows it models the base and both induction instances but refutes irreflexivity, giving non-entailment and non-derivability via soundness. Builds a three-element Fin-3 countermodel with sole number modeling the Simpson base but refuting zero-or-successor, giving its non-entailment and non-derivability.
files.conclusion: Neither irreflexivity follows from the two-instance extension nor zero-or-successor follows from the Simpson base.

files.summary: This file defines number-relativized Simpson basic axioms, the induction-instance operator IND, bounded-quantifier formulas, and the theories built from them. It proves the Simpson base derives x less than its successor without induction and proves a theory-translation cut lemma. It then shows one bounded zero-or-successor induction instance derives the zero-or-successor axiom and the predecessor-descent sentence, and that any theory containing the base and that instance, including the full bounded-induction theory, does the same.
files.conclusion: A single bounded zero-or-successor induction instance added to finite Simpson arithmetic derives predecessor descent, and so does every theory containing them.

files.summary: This file arithmetizes a singleton dependency-pair bound as an explicit for-all exists L2 sentence and proves it Pi02 with standard-model semantics equivalent to a natural-number counter bound. It defines one-thread size-change graphs and proves no infinite call chain exists, a bounded for-all exists form, and well-foundedness. It extracts the DupDPStep pair from the step-duplicating recursor, instantiates the general results, and computes its exact well-founded rank and ordinal height omega.
files.conclusion: The extracted DupDPStep relation is chain-free, well-founded and bounded with exact pointwise rank equal to its counter and global ordinal height omega, equivalent to satisfaction of the displayed Pi02 sentence.

files.summary: This file defines the standard model carrier N plus powersets of N and its interpretations of L2 function and relation symbols, with order as less-than, membership, and IsSet as the set side. It packages these as the L2-structure stdStructure with inhabited and nonempty instances. It includes six computational smoke examples checking zero, successor, addition, order, and positive and negative IsSet cases.
files.conclusion: The file fixes the standard L2-structure on N plus Set N with totalized arithmetic and set-membership semantics.

files.summary: This file defines parallel capture-avoiding substitution substAll for de Bruijn bound variables with lifting under quantifiers, plus the single-variable instantiation instantiateTop. It proves realization lemmas saying syntactic substitution commutes with semantic realization in any structure. These lemmas support the specialization axiom and existential introduction of the first-order derivation system.
files.conclusion: Parallel substitution and top instantiation commute with realization, giving the semantic content of universal specialization.

files.summary: This file defines profile records for second-order theories and principles with implication, conservativity and equivalence, plus upper bounds, lower bounds and calibrations carrying evidence status. It instantiates PRA, IΣ1, RCA0, RCA0 + WO(ω^3) and WO(ε₀) profiles and gives an exact SCT calibration alongside a conjectural Arts–Giesl calibration. It proves the two calibrations share target theory and ordinal, that the Arts–Giesl target lies below its ε₀ benchmark, and that justification and presentation erasures preserve theory and status while clearing metadata.
files.conclusion: Size-change termination is exactly calibrated at RCA0 + WO(ω^3) sharing that target with the conjectural Arts–Giesl calibration below WO(ε₀), with exactness transferable across principles.

files.summary: This file defines the ordinal ω^3 and its canonical carrier with proofs that it is positive, below ε₀, well-founded and of order type ω^3. It proves general ordinal descent soundness and its ω^3 and Nat-measure specializations with a strictly monotone Nat embedding. It proves every ordinal below ω^3 occurs as a carrier rank and packages a canonical order-type witness and WO(ω^3) backing proposition.
files.conclusion: The canonical ω^3 carrier is well-founded with order type ω^3 and every ordinal below ω^3 occurs as a rank while decreasing ranks guarantee termination.

files.summary: This file defines calibration statuses, theory and ordinal windows and combined profiles with explicit ω^3 and ω^ω constants proved below ε₀. It registers exact SCT windows and conjectural Arts–Giesl windows sharing theory and ordinal targets, plus a packaged ε₀ artifact upper bound already supplied by the KO7 measure stack. It models constant-overhead transformation with a step-duplicating recursor instance preserving linear growth and summarizes the supported Arts–Giesl target facts.
files.conclusion: Registered SCT exact and Arts–Giesl conjectural profiles share theory target RCA0 + WO(ω^3) and ordinal target ω^3 below ε₀ with a constant-overhead recursor transformation preserving linear growth.

files.summary: This file records named termination principles with calibration profiles and registry entries for SCT as exact and Arts-Giesl as conjectural at the same RCA0 plus WO omega cubed target. It defines profile-level alignments and a theorem-level Arts-Giesl over SCT schema with a current profile-level alignment object. It proves the current alignment is not theorem-level but agrees on shared targets, and gives a generic bridge from an exact calibration transfer to a theorem-level alignment.
files.conclusion: The current Arts-Giesl over SCT alignment is only profile-level, with a generic construction showing what exact transfer would promote it to theorem level.

files.summary: This file exercises the Arts-Giesl derivational-complexity certificate machinery and instantiates it for the KO7 kernel. It provides a Fintype instance for the seven-symbol kernel signature, an identity affine base-order bound, and two canonical single-application audits for the KO7 first-order and head engines. It then checks license-overhead equalities, residual-work equations, and polynomial total-length bounds, including quadratic-in-rules bounds scaled by signature size.
files.conclusion: The KO7 first-order and head audits satisfy explicit polynomial total-length bounds in rule count and signature size plus residual cost.

files.summary: This file is a regression surface for the named concrete SCT-sharp transfer pair and the exact theorem-calibration object. It checks that upper and lower transfers carry theorem-level evidence over theory RCA0_WO_omega3 with ordinal ceiling omega^3, and that the derived calibration has exact status with matching target profile. It also checks a second construction via theorem alignment, route-comparison equalities, and tag- and presentation-erasure equivalences between the two routes.
files.conclusion: The concrete SCT-sharp transfers yield an exact theorem calibration at RCA0_WO_omega3 with omega^3, with both routes agreeing even after erasures.

files.summary: This file is a reach gate for the Pi11 calibration of bare Newman. It checks the single declaration bareNewman_pi11_calibration with `#check @` and `#print axioms`. It proves no new content.
files.conclusion: The gate certifies reachability and axiom closure for the bare Newman Pi11 calibration.

files.summary: This file is a paired reach and axiom gate for ConfluenceOrderType. It checks the confluence measure order type, its trace bound, and the strict bound below epsilon0. It proves no new content and only audits reachability and axioms.
files.conclusion: The confluence measure has order type below epsilon0 with a trace bound.

files.summary: This paired reach and axiom gate checks guarded Newman exact calibration, including the guarded statement, the omega to the omega squared upper bound and order descriptors below epsilon0. It prints axiom closures for the closing theorems.
files.conclusion: Guarded confluence closes at omega to the omega squared below epsilon0.

files.summary: This paired reach and axiom gate checks the guarded Newman RCA0 development, including the upper bound, package and order below epsilon0. It prints axiom closures for the package theorems.
files.conclusion: The guarded Newman upper package is provable with order below epsilon0.

files.summary: This file gates Newman complexity classifications. It checks arithmetical closure under negation, infinitary conjunction and disjunction, Newman conclusion, step and body sentences, set-guarded arithmetical and Pi11 notions, arithmetical and Pi11 classifications of Newman components, and lowness and Sigma0 classifications of confluent joinability.
files.conclusion: The file records reachability and axiom footprints for Newman arithmetical and Pi11 classifications and low Sigma0 joinability.

files.summary: The file is a paired reach and axiom gate for the RCA0 upper bound with no new definitions. It checks that the standard model satisfies the Newman sentence, satisfies RCA0 basic and Simpson basic axioms with Newman, and that both axiom sets are consistent with Newman, printing axioms for each. It proves nothing; it confirms reachability and axiom footprints.
files.conclusion: RCA0 basic and Simpson basic fragments are each consistent with the Newman sentence in the standard model.

files.summary: This file gives full reach and axiom coverage for finite sharpness models. It checks the two-induction fragment, its two-element countermodel validating Simpson arithmetic and the fragment while refuting irreflexivity, and the resulting non-entailment and non-derivability. It also checks the base-insufficiency countermodel refuting zero-or-succ and the resulting non-entailment and non-derivability. No new definitions or theorems are declared.
files.conclusion: The file confirms that every named sharpness-model declaration elaborates and reports its axioms without adding new content.

files.summary: This file gives full reach and axiom coverage for the RCA0Derivations module. It checks successor, addition, multiplication and order axioms, Simpson basic theory and relativizations, induction and bounded-quantifier notions, and two induction formulas with boundedness proofs. It also checks derivations of successor and zero-or-succ laws and predecessor descent within zero-or-succ and bounded-induction fragments. No new definitions or theorems are declared.
files.conclusion: The file confirms that every named RCA0Derivations declaration elaborates and reports its axioms without adding new content.
